item.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
item.source: Australian Bureau of Statistics, statistical dataset
item.opening: Dataset: CPI. The Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures changes in the price of a 'basket' of goods and services which account for a high proportion of expenditure by the CPI population group (i.e. metropolitan households). Unit of measure: Index. Geographic coverage: Australia/State. Catalogue number: 6401.0
